# Jomiez Innovation

> Jomiez Innovation is a world-class software development company based in Africa, serving a global clientele. Founded by Ezinna Emmanuel Nweke (Templeton), we specialize in building scalable web applications, mobile apps, enterprise software, SaaS platforms, and integrating Artificial Intelligence solutions into business workflows.

- **Contact Us**: [https://jomiez.com/contact-us](https://jomiez.com/contact-us) - Get in touch for a free consultation.

## Core Expertise
- **Custom Software Development**: Full-stack solutions using React, Node.js, Python, etc.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform apps (iOS & Android).
- **AI & Automation**: Integrating OpenAI, Gemini, Claude and other LLMs into applications.
- **Digital Transformation**: Modernizing legacy systems to cloud-native architectures.
- **UI/UX Design**: Creating intuitive and beautiful user experiences.
